dashboard.description: Cost per m³ by plant, designs by lifecycle state, stale prices and expired tests will appear here once designs are evaluated.

studio.description: Evaluate an existing mix or generate a trial recommendation, step by step, with every number explained.

library.description: Approved, in-production and trial designs, with versions, trial results and lifecycle history.

insights.description: Price, test and strength changes that deserve a second look will be triaged here, never as interruptions.

savings.description: Theoretical, approved and realized savings are shown side by side and never added together.

materials.description: Add a sieve test for each aggregate to unlock blend optimization. Test freshness and drift appear here.

prices.description: One matrix of materials by plant, with history, stale-price flags and Excel paste.

plants.description: Plants, their location and ambient profile, and the materials priced at each.

rules.description: ACI and Jordanian code values with clause references. Every value stays unverified until a QC manager checks it.

imports.description: Bring existing approved mix designs in from a spreadsheet, then attest each one to make it a baseline.

settings.description: Tenant settings such as plant limit, stale-price threshold and number format.

profiles.description: Reusable characteristic profiles for plants and product families, with versions and four-eyes approval.

shell.noNotificationsHint: Critical alerts about strength results and expired tests will appear here.
shell.demoBanner: SYNTHETIC demo data: nothing here is real

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use the account your administrator created for you.
auth.failed: Could not sign in. Try again.

errors.forbiddenHint: This section is hidden for your role. Ask an administrator if you need access.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Your entries are still on screen; try again.

dev.title: Components
dev.intro: Every shared component in LTR and RTL. Theme and density follow the toolbar.
dev.chips: Status, source, evidence and saving chips
dev.tabOneBody: Material quantities per cubic metre appear here.
dev.tabTwoBody: Requirement, governing value and margin appear here.
dev.dialogBody: Designs are proposals that require trial batching and QC approval.
dev.popoverBody: Formula, inputs, rule and clause appear here.
dev.tooltip: Explains where a number comes from
dev.emptyBody: Add a sieve test for this aggregate to unlock blend optimization.

rules.intro: Code values and engineering parameters with their clause references. Every value starts as an unverified transcription candidate until a QC manager checks it against the licensed document.
rules.engineeringIntro: Engineering parameters are plant and workability guardrails set by QC, not code values. Empty values stay empty until QC sets them.

banner.title: {unverified} rule values are unverified and {missing} are not on file ({verified} verified).
banner.body: Designs cannot be approved on unverified or missing values. Open a rule to verify it against the licensed document.

verify.title: Verify rule value
verify.description: Confirm that this value and clause match the licensed document. This is a signed action and is recorded with your note.
verify.notePlaceholder: For example: Checked against ACI 318-19 Table 19.3.2.1, row S2
verify.noteHint: Type at least 5 characters. You cannot verify a value you changed yourself.

edit.title: Correct rule value
edit.description: This creates version {version}, which must be verified again. The current version stays in the history.
edit.reasonPlaceholder: Why is the current value wrong?
edit.warning: The corrected value will be unverified until a different QC manager verifies it.

hint.default: Enter the value in the rule's units.
hint.limit_max: A number, or a fraction like 1/3.
hint.limit_min: A number, or a fraction like 1/3.
hint.prohibition: true if prohibited, false if permitted.
hint.table: JSON table definition (rows, cols, data, interpolation).

import.intro: Upload the Jordanian code values as a CSV. The file is checked first and nothing changes until you commit. Imported values start unverified.
import.summary: {total} rows: {ok} will change, {unchanged} unchanged, {errors} with errors.
import.fixFirst: Fix the errors in the file and check it again.

materials.intro: The materials you design with, their characteristics and where each value came from. Every value keeps its source: lab report, supplier datasheet, or declared by a person.

empty.title: No materials yet
empty.description: Add a material and its characteristics. SG and absorption are enough to evaluate a mix; a sieve analysis is needed to generate one.

materials.fmMissing: cannot be computed yet: missing sieves {sieves} mm
materials.declaredKey: Key values typed by a person, not from a document: {fields}

drift.beyond: {field} moved from {from} to {to}, beyond the tolerance QC set.
drift.noTol: {field} moved from {from} to {to} (no drift tolerance is set).

sheet.upgrade: Attach a report to declared values
sheet.noTest: No test has been recorded for this material.

entry.intro: Enter what you have. Nothing is assumed: values you leave empty stay empty, and every value is stored with its source.
entry.sgConfirmed: I confirmed the water specific gravity (1.000 is not assumed)
entry.pasteHint: Paste from Excel: a row of sieve sizes above a row of % passing, or two columns. Values are read as % passing.
entry.wrHint: Water reduction at each dosage (at least 3 points, dosage ascending). Dosage is % of cementitious mass.
entry.sanity: {field} = {value} is outside the usual range {min} to {max}. You can still save it.
entry.sourceTitle: Where do these values come from?
entry.sourceHint: This decides how far the values can be trusted. Declared values are always flagged on every design that uses them.

sourceDesc.lab_report: From a lab report. The report file must be attached.
sourceDesc.supplier_datasheet: From the supplier’s datasheet (attaching it is recommended).
sourceDesc.user_declared: Typed by you without a document. You will be asked why.

entry.attachHint: PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB.
entry.reason: Why is this declared without a document?
entry.reasonPlaceholder: For example: bench measurement on site, report to follow
entry.warnings: {count} value(s) outside the usual range. Saved anyway.
entry.offline: You are offline. Your entries are kept on this device as a draft; save when the connection returns.
entry.draftFound: A draft from {when} was found on this device.

tier.designHint: Also needed for Generate. Anything missing is named as a blocker.
tier.optionalHint: Improves checks and models; never assumed when empty.

gradErr.too_few_points: A gradation needs at least two sieves
gradErr.unknown_sieve: {sieve} mm is not a standard sieve
gradErr.out_of_range: % passing at {sieve} mm must be between 0 and 100
gradErr.not_monotonic: % passing rises at {sieve} mm; it must never increase toward finer sieves
gradErr.top_not_100: The largest sieve must show 100% passing

cement.suggest: Suggested from the name: {label}. Confirm it before using it.
cement.hint: These are labels. Checks use the tested values (C3A, alkali, pozzolan, mortar strength), never the label.

plants.intro: Your batching plants. Prices, materials and designs are scoped to a plant.
plants.formHint: The code is how the plant appears in lists and exports.

empty.title: No plants yet
empty.description: Add your first plant to start entering materials and prices.

settings.intro: Organisation-wide settings and users. Engineering parameters live in the rules library, not here.
settings.nearLimitPct: Near-limit warning (% of the limit; empty = no warnings)
settings.insightMinAnnual: Minimum annual saving worth an insight
settings.sanityHint: Typed values outside these ranges are flagged but never blocked. Leave a field empty for no limit.
settings.requiresLabHint: When on, a design that relies on user-declared key values cannot be approved. Enforced when approvals arrive.
settings.productionHint: Used by batch weights and the PDF submittal.
settings.solutionWater: Subtract admixture solution water from batch water
settings.solutionWaterHint: Off by default: the convention differs per product. When on, solution water (mass × (1 − solids %)) is subtracted and named in the conversion.
settings.letterheadHint: Leave the names empty to print a plain header with the plant name. Both names are needed.

authority.adminOnly: You can change the organisational settings. Settings that shape evidence, validity limits and acceptance need engineering authority (a QC manager) and are locked here.
authority.engineeringOnly: You can change the settings that shape evidence, validity limits and acceptance. Organisational settings need an administrator and are locked here.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Create users, set their role and plants, reset a password or deactivate. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
users.newHint: The person signs in with this email and password. Share the password securely.
users.plantsHint: Admin and QC Manager see every plant. Other roles see only the plants ticked here.
users.ownRole: You cannot change your own role.
users.roleReasonHint: Granting or removing an engineering role is recorded with this reason in the audit trail.

prices.intro: What each material costs delivered to each plant. Every change is kept: a new price closes the old one, nothing is overwritten. A missing price means “not available here”, never zero.
prices.asOfNote: Showing the prices that were in force on {date}. This view is read-only.
prices.rowUnitShort: Price unit for the selected row
prices.save: Save {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}
prices.staleCount: {count, plural, one {# stale price} other {# stale prices}}
prices.notConvertibleCount: {count} cannot be converted to JOD/kg yet
prices.keys: Keys: arrows move, Shift+arrows select a range, Enter or typing edits, Ctrl+V pastes from Excel, Ctrl+Z undoes, Delete drops a pending change.

empty.title: Nothing to price yet
empty.description: Add plants and materials first, then enter prices here.

paste.problems: Pasted {ok}; {errors} invalid and {clipped} outside the table were skipped

history.title: Price history
history.supplierHint: Several suppliers are priced here. The preferred one is used for costing.

bulk.title: Change prices by a percentage
bulk.hint: Applies to the prices in force today. See what will change before you apply.
bulk.zero: 0 % re-confirms current prices as of today (resets their age).
bulk.preview: {count, plural, one {# price will change} other {# prices will change}}

copy.title: Copy prices to another plant
copy.hint: Copies the supplier, price and unit. Plants that already have a price are skipped unless you overwrite.
copy.overwrite: Also replace prices the target plant already has

import.title: Import from Excel or CSV
import.hint: The file is checked row by row first. Nothing is saved until you confirm, and a file with any error is never half-applied.
import.columns: Columns: material, plant, supplier (optional), price, unit, includes delivery (optional), effective from (optional), reason.
import.summary: {total} rows: {ok} to apply, {unchanged} unchanged, {errors} with errors

importErr.bad_delivery_flag: Use yes or no for delivery
importErr.reason_required: A back-dated price needs a reason

snapshot.title: Price snapshots
snapshot.hint: A snapshot freezes the prices in force today under a name. It can never be changed, so a later saving cannot be confused with a price movement.
snapshot.name: Snapshot name

supplier.title: Which supplier?
supplier.hint: {count} cells have no supplier yet. Choose the supplier these prices come from.

library.intro: Your mix designs. Open one and press Evaluate to calculate compliance, cost and data quality; every result is rechecked by an independent validator. Until then a design shows exactly what your file said.
library.queueHint: Imported designs nobody has attested yet. Attesting records that the design was approved outside Khalta; a second QC manager (not the person who imported) must do it.

empty.title: No designs yet
empty.description: Import your existing mix designs from Excel or CSV to start.

emptyQueue.title: Nothing awaiting attestation
emptyQueue.description: Every imported design has been attested.

library.legacyNotEvaluated: Legacy attested · not yet evaluated by Khalta
library.evaluationPending: Not evaluated yet: open the Evaluation tab and press Evaluate. No compliance, cost or strength figure is shown until Khalta has calculated it.

warn.material_not_priced: Material is not priced at this plant
warn.test_age_missing: Test age is missing in the file

attest.title: Attest {code}
attest.hint: Record that this design was approved outside Khalta. Your name, the reference and your note are kept permanently.
attest.fourEyes: You imported this file, so you cannot attest it. Another QC manager must.
attest.notePlaceholder: For example: checked against the signed submittal 2025-14
attest.scope: Attesting says this mix was approved outside Khalta. It does not say Khalta checked it; Khalta will evaluate it later and flag anything that needs revalidation.

library.revalidationHint: Attested designs whose latest evaluation failed a hard check. They keep their state; nothing is suspended automatically.

emptyRevalidation.title: Nothing needs revalidation
emptyRevalidation.description: No attested design has a failing evaluation.

library.trialHint: Trial candidates and designs in a trial. A trial is required before approval.
library.awaitingHint: Trial passed; waiting for a QC manager other than the author to approve.

emptyTrial.title: No designs in trial
emptyTrial.description: Trial candidates from the Studio appear here.

emptyAwaiting.title: Nothing awaiting approval
emptyAwaiting.description: Designs that passed their trial appear here.

imports.intro: Bring in existing mix designs from Excel or CSV. The file is checked before anything is saved; nothing is half-imported.
imports.fileHint: One row per material line (see templates/legacy-mix-designs.csv). Headers in English or Arabic are recognised.
imports.mapHint: Each field is matched to a column by its header. Correct any that are wrong.
imports.matchHint: A name is linked automatically only when it is exactly your library name (ignoring spelling variants). Everything else needs your choice.
imports.summary: {designs} designs: {ok} ready, {errors} with errors; {unresolved} materials still need a choice
imports.commitHint: Designs are created as drafts, awaiting evaluation and attestation.

check.scm_max_fly_ash_silica_fume_pct: Fly ash, pozzolan and silica fume

adequacy.model_design_at_or_below_baseline: The design w/cm is at or below the plant model's value.

reason.fcr_unavailable: The required average strength f′cr is not available.

reason.dosage_level_from_m31: The requested dosage level is compared from M3.1.

reason.scm_type_missing: The SCM type is not recorded for {materials}.
reason.admixture_type_missing: The admixture type is not recorded for {materials}.

savings.intro: Cost baselines and theoretical opportunities. Nothing here is approved or realized: opportunities are estimates that need a trial and approval, and they are never added together.
savings.baselineHint: A baseline fixes what an attested design costs per m³ at one named price snapshot. It is never re-priced; later comparisons use the same snapshot, so price movements are never credited to a change.

noBaselines.title: No baselines yet
noBaselines.description: A QC manager can create one from an attested design and a saved price snapshot.

savings.opportunityHint: THEORETICAL: a manual variant that passes every evaluated check, was verified by the independent validator, and is cheaper at the baseline’s own prices. It is not approved and has not been tested.

noEntries.title: No opportunities yet
noEntries.description: Edit a baselined design as a new version, evaluate it, and press “Price as an opportunity”.

savings.baselineDialogHint: Choose an attested design and a saved price snapshot. The design is evaluated at that snapshot and the cost must be complete and verified.
savings.noSnapshots: No price snapshot exists yet: create one on the Prices screen first.

reason.cost_incomplete: A material has no usable price in the snapshot.

savings.boardHint: Three states, never added together. Theoretical is an estimate at current prices; approved is the saving of an approved replacement at one price snapshot; realized is the measured month, both costs at that month's snapshot times the volume produced.

stateHint.theoretical: Estimates from opportunities. No trial yet.
stateHint.approved: A replacement was approved. Per year is an estimate from the monthly volume.
stateHint.realized: Measured months with a recorded volume and a month snapshot.

savings.noTotal: Each estimate stands alone and is not totalled.

blocked.title: Months that cannot be measured yet
blocked.hint: A month is measured only when its volume and its price snapshot exist. Nothing is estimated in their place.

reason.no_snapshot: No price snapshot for the month
reason.cost_incomplete: A material has no usable price

req.cementColourHint: White cement is only used when you choose it; grey excludes white cement.

pool.hint: Materials usable at this plant (tested, priced, in date). Click a chip to leave it out of this request.

conflict.hardIntro: Even with every value you set released, these limits cannot be met together. Nothing can be released here, and no saving is offered.
conflict.none: No single limit could be named.

profiles.intro: A characteristic profile is a reusable set of mix preferences for a plant, a product family, or the whole company. A profile tightens a request and never loosens a code or project limit. A draft can be used for evaluation; only an approved profile can drive trial-candidate generation.

profiles.inForce: Version {version} stays in force until this draft is approved.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle

code.stale_state: The design changed since you opened it; reload it

meaning.pass-trial: You confirm that the trial criteria are met and you have reviewed the results.
meaning.approve: You approve this design for production use. A trial passed, the rules are verified and the evidence is current.
meaning.release: You release this approved design to production at its plant.
meaning.retire: You retire this design. It cannot be used again; a new version is needed.
meaning.accept: You accept that some key values are user-declared and not from a lab report or datasheet.
meaning.suspend: You suspend this design. It stops being available for production until a QC manager reinstates it. Nothing suspends automatically.
meaning.reinstate: You reinstate this suspended design and confirm the reason for suspension no longer applies.
meaning.acceptAssumptions: You accept, with your signature, the values the evaluator assumed because nobody recorded them. They remain listed on the design.

sign.scope: A typed e-signature records who signed, in what role, what it means, why, when, and the exact version of the design. It does not claim legal validity.
